verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a Python SDK with tracing decorators, spans querying, and a modular API reference (docs-28,29,30,36,68), plus a remote MCP endpoint that lets any MCP-compatible client programmatically query/operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, and prompts (docs-58,69, probe-4). However, a direct probe for a public OpenAPI/REST spec returned 404 on all standard paths (probe-3), so there's no clear documented general REST API beyond the SDK/MCP surface. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST API spec, independent/community corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
